{{Current events|year=2025|month=03|day=2|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[2025 Gaza war ceasefire]]
***[[Israel]] agrees to a [[United States]]-led plan to extend the first phase of the [[ceasefire]] through [[Ramadan]] and [[Passover]], during which half of the 59 [[Gaza war hostage crisis|remaining hostages]] will be released. [[Hamas]] rejects the proposal, insisting that the deal proceed with phase two, which includes the release of all remaining living hostages, a full withdrawal of [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli troops]] from [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] and a permanent end to the war. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/as-truce-enters-limbo-israel-gives-diplomacy-with-hamas-one-last-chance-before-resuming-war/ (''The Times of Israel'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[97th Academy Awards]]
**The 97th [[Academy Awards]] take place at the [[Dolby Theatre]] in [[Los Angeles]], [[United States]]. ''[[Anora]]'' wins the most awards, taking five, including [[Academy Award for Best Picture|Best Picture]] and [[Academy Award for Best Actress|Best Actress]] for [[Mikey Madison]]. [[Adrien Brody]] wins [[Academy Award for Best Actor|Best Actor]] for ''[[The Brutalist]]''. [https://www.reuters.com/lifestyle/oscars-take-stage-sunday-with-best-picture-up-grabs-2025-03-02/ (Reuters)]
**''Anora'' director [[Sean Baker]] becomes the first person to win four Academy Awards (Best Picture, [[Academy Award for Best Director|Best Director]], [[Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay|Best Original Screenplay]], and [[Academy Award for Best Film Editing|Best Film Editing]]) for a single film, also tying [[Walt Disney]]'s record for [[List of people who have won multiple Academy Awards in a single year|most Academy Awards won in a single ceremony]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/arts-entertainment/films/news/sean-baker-oscars-history-anora-b2707793.html (''The Independent'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Southeastern United States wildfires]]
**Several [[Wildfire|wildfires]] erupt across [[South Carolina]] and [[North Carolina]], [[United States]], resulting in the evacuation of endangered towns, including several in the [[Myrtle Beach, South Carolina|Myrtle Beach]] area. [[Governor of South Carolina|South Carolina governor]] [[Henry McMaster]] declares a [[state of emergency]] in response. [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/03/01/us/fire-north-carolina.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.nbcnews.com/weather/wildfires/south-carolina-governor-declares-state-emergency-raging-wildfires-prom-rcna194395 (NBC)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Coalition of the willing (Russo-Ukrainian War)]]
***[[United Kingdom]] [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|prime minister]] [[Keir Starmer]] announces after a [[2025 London Summit on Ukraine|meeting]] of [[European Union]] leaders in [[London]] that a "[[coalition of the willing (Russo-Ukrainian War)|coalition of the willing]]" is working on a [[Ukraine]] peace plan that they will present to [[U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/uk-to-defend-ukraine-peace-deal-with-coalition-of-willing-starmer-says-13320159 (Sky News)]
**[[Russia–United States relations]]
***[[United States Secretary of Defense]] [[Pete Hegseth]] orders a halt to offensive cyber operations and information operations against Russia by [[U.S. Cyber Command]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/trump-administration/defense-secretary-pete-hegseth-orders-halt-offensive-cyber-operations-rcna194435 (NBC News)]

'''Politics and elections''' 
*[[2025 Abkhazian presidential election]]
**Acting leader of [[Abkhazia]] [[Badra Gunba]] is elected [[President of Abkhazia|President]] with 55% of the votes. [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]] rejects the election, as it [[Russian-occupied territories in Georgia|claims Abkhazia as part of its territory]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/breakaway-abkhazias-acting-leader-wins-presidential-election-state-media-says-2025-03-02/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Firefly Aerospace]] successfully lands the [[Blue Ghost Mission 1]] on the [[Moon]] as part of [[NASA]]'s [[Commercial Lunar Payload Services]] program, delivering payloads to [[Mare Crisium]] with instruments to study [[lunar regolith]]s and the interactions between [[solar wind]] and [[Earth]]'s [[Earth's magnetic field|magnetic field]]. [https://www.space.com/the-universe/moon/were-on-the-moon-private-blue-ghost-moon-lander-aces-historic-lunar-landing-for-nasa (Space.com)] [https://www.nasa.gov/news-release/touchdown-carrying-nasa-science-fireflys-blue-ghost-lands-on-moon/ (NASA)]
